title: Sice Previt S.p.A.
description:
[retail] Sice Previt S.p.A. is an Italian construction and luxury-retail fit-out company headquartered at Via degli Alpini 14, 20090 Segrate (MI), Italy (fiscal code 14288610968). The company operates through three entities: Sice Previt S.p.A. (Italy), Sice Previt France SAS (Paris), and Sice Previt UK Ltd (London), under the parent holding Sice Group S.r.l. (00845010156). Founded as a metalwork and construction firm, Sice Previt evolved into a specialist luxury-retail fit-out contractor serving the world's most prominent fashion and luxury brands. FY 2025 revenue: EUR 98.2M. Headcount: approximately 291–350 employees across the three jurisdictions. The company's contracted order book as of June 2026 stands at EUR 170.7M, with a total pipeline of EUR 229.6M dominated by LVMH (57.9%), Castello SGR, Ferrari, Balenciaga, YSL, Gucci, and other luxury brands.

The dataset comprises approximately 886 GB exfiltrated across 20 Level-1 directories on the company's primary file server, capturing the complete digital footprint of the enterprise: HR records (24 GB RISORSEUMANE), accounting and treasury (243 GB SP-AMMINISTRAZIONE, 90 GB SF-AMMINISTRAZIONE), project archives (379 GB COMMESSE with 1,053 project folders), email and PC backups (101 GB BACKUP_MAIL_PC), executive evaluations (298 MB DIRETTIVO), business intelligence (160 MB POWER_BI), and ancillary systems (ARCADOC, NIBBIO ERP, JDOC, COOP, LED, SICUREZZA, ALICE, FACTORY).
